ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is the highest in the food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a marine food web diagram, with multiple organism names placed in boxes and connected by arrows. The box at the highest position in the upper left is labeled “killer whale”. Around it, it is connected to animals such as great whales, harbour seal, Steller sea lion, and sea otters; there is no other predator box in the diagram located above killer whale. Other organisms such as sea otters, bald eagle, gulls, sea urchins, and kelp are located in lower or adjacent positions. Reasoning: The question asks “what is the highest in the food chain”, that is, it asks about the highest trophic level or apex predator. Based on the position and connection relationships in the diagram, killer whale is at the top layer of the food web and has no higher predator, so the highest is killer whale.
